scope: Frozen production Chromium/Metal targeted normal/reduced physical handlamp pass. One belfry start per motion mode, then only ordinary W presses through both real spiral descents. Explicit physical bearings face each actual turret opening. Actual F raises/restores the normal handlamp at both mouths and midstairs. No exposure overrides, renderer substitutions or warps after the start. Exact actual WebP canvas bytes are buffered in memory until browser/profilecleanup, then atomically saved; a null capture path is not visual evidence. Excludes lessons, combat and endings.

visualAssessment.acceptanceScope: Church handlamp hotspot correction and readable stair depth in the existing dither treatment, at the tested desktop Chromium/Metal resolution. This is not a claim that every scene, device or ending is visually accepted.
visualAssessment.upperMouth: First tread faces, their edges, the rail and masonry remain separate under the calibrated beam.
visualAssessment.lowerMouth: Unchanged-bearing view retains masonry/diagonal surface detail across the former featureless pale disk. Actual-first-tread bearing shows the tread fan and rail separately from the drum wall in normal and reduced motion.
visualAssessment.midStairs: Nearest horizontal tread faces remain bright, but their edge/rail and the farther wall/depth remain distinct; the large clipped far-wall hotspot is removed.
visualAssessment.torchOff: Dim stippled interiors are retained; no exposure override or global grade change was used.
visualAssessment.limits: Targeted18/18 ordinary-input checks and34actual-canvas frames supplement the prior44/44 normal/reduced functional route pass. Entry is established once per mode; earned Source access, combat and ending acceptance are outside this verifier.

imageComparison.method: Same-bearing normal lower-mouth WebP images, grayscale threshold217/255, largest4-connected bright component. This is a screenshot clipping proxy, not a photometric measurement.
